items.en: Typhoon Dolphin Triggers Sea Warning for Taiwan as Father's Day Weekend Approaches
items.zh: 白海豚颱風發布海警，父親節連假最接近台灣
items.summary: Taiwan's Central Weather Administration issued a sea warning for Typhoon Dolphin, the season's 13th storm, at 2:30pm on August 7, and the central emergency response centre opened at level two. Forecasters expect the storm to pass closest to Taiwan between August 8 and 10, with the weekend bringing the heaviest impact. Northern mountain areas could see 350 to 500 millimetres of accumulated rain, while northern lowlands face heavy to extremely heavy rainfall. A land warning has not been ruled out for Matsu, New Taipei and Keelung's north coast on Saturday. All 22 cities reported normal operations as of Friday evening.

items.en: Trump Says US Has 'Massive Amounts' of Munitions After Reports of Low Stockpile
items.zh: 川普稱美軍彈藥「數量龐大」，回應庫存吃緊報導
items.summary: President Trump pushed back on reporting that US munitions stockpiles have been drawn down by the Iran campaign, saying America holds 'massive amounts' of weapons. He repeated that he called off what he described as the largest US strike on another country since World War Two because Tehran wanted to negotiate, while warning Iran would be hit 'really hard' absent a deal. Iran continues to deny direct talks are underway. Oil rose on the standoff, with Brent climbing nearly four percent on Thursday as traders priced in risk to Strait of Hormuz shipping.

items.en: Israel Weighs Resuming Strikes as Hamas Disarmament Deal Wobbles
items.zh: 哈瑪斯繳械協議生變，以色列考慮恢復空襲
items.summary: Israeli officials are reported to be discussing open defiance of the Gaza roadmap by resuming strikes, describing Hamas's delays on disarmament as a strategic ambush. The days-old agreement brokered by Washington is already under strain, and Israel separately struck targets in Lebanon after accusing Hezbollah of violating the ceasefire. Mediators say the sequencing of weapons handovers remains the central sticking point, with neither side willing to move first. Regional analysts warn a collapse would reopen a front just as Gulf states brace for Houthi and Iraqi militia attacks.

items.en: Wall Street Pulls Back From Records as Oil Jumps Ahead of Jobs Report
items.zh: 油價跳漲、非農前夕觀望，美股自歷史高點回落
items.summary: US stocks closed modestly lower on Thursday as investors paused after a rally that had lifted major indexes to record levels. The Dow fell 464 points, or 0.85 percent, to 53,885.10, the S&P 500 slipped 0.18 percent to 7,709.96, and the Nasdaq edged down 0.06 percent to 26,348.35. Brent crude climbed almost four percent on renewed Strait of Hormuz uncertainty, lifting energy shares but pressuring transport and manufacturing. Treasury yields rose as traders positioned ahead of Friday's July employment report, which is now the market's next major catalyst.

items.en: US Presses On With Ukraine Patriot Talks Despite Trump's Doubts
items.zh: 川普存疑，美方仍推進對烏愛國者飛彈談判
items.summary: Washington is continuing negotiations over Patriot air-defence deliveries to Ukraine even as President Trump publicly questions the value of further transfers, according to a Friday policy briefing. Separately, former European and Russian officials have been exploring possible peace terms through unofficial channels, though neither government has endorsed the effort. The talks come as Kyiv presses for interceptor resupply ahead of an expected autumn campaign against its power grid. Allied capitals are watching whether US hesitancy shifts more of the funding burden onto European budgets.

items.en: Datadog Plunges 19% as Software Earnings Trigger a Sector-Wide Slide
items.zh: Datadog 暴跌 19%，軟體股財報引爆賣壓
items.summary: Datadog fell about 15 to 19 percent on Thursday after revenue guidance disappointed, leading a broad software selloff that dragged down cloud and observability peers. AppLovin sank 19.3 percent on its own weak outlook. The moves illustrate how unforgiving the market has become toward high-multiple names that miss on forward guidance, even in a quarter where more than four of every five S&P 500 reporters beat estimates. Analysts framed the reaction as valuation compression rather than a verdict on demand, noting bookings across the group still grew.

items.en: Western Digital and SanDisk Slump on Storage Forecasts, Dragging Chip Names
items.zh: 威騰與 SanDisk 財測失色，拖累儲存與晶片族群
items.summary: Western Digital tumbled roughly 13 percent and SanDisk dropped 6.8 percent after both issued storage forecasts that fell short of expectations, pulling the wider memory and chip complex lower on Thursday. The reaction is notable because memory pricing has been one of the strongest bull cases in semiconductors this year, and Taiwanese memory suppliers had rallied hard on the same theme. Investors are now testing whether the shortage narrative is peaking or simply pausing, with Apple reportedly rushing DRAM purchases weeks before the iPhone 18 launch.

items.en: SpaceX Rebounds 6% After Insider Lockup Expires; Musk Commits to Nvidia-Only AI Build
items.zh: SpaceX 解禁後反彈 6%，馬斯克宣示 AI 算力只用輝達
items.summary: SpaceX shares erased intraday losses and closed about 6.1 percent higher on Thursday as the first insider lockup expiration passed with less selling than feared, a week after the company's debut earnings knocked the stock down sharply on a sixfold jump in capital spending. Elon Musk said SpaceX will use only Nvidia processors when it builds out artificial-intelligence computing infrastructure, a remark that had already helped lift Nvidia 3.4 percent in the prior session. More than 900 million shares became eligible for sale.

items.en: NFL Preseason Opens With Hall of Fame Game Between Cardinals and Panthers
items.zh: NFL 季前賽開打，名人堂賽由紅雀對黑豹揭幕
items.summary: The NFL preseason began on August 6 with the annual Hall of Fame Game in Canton, Ohio, pitting the Arizona Cardinals against the Carolina Panthers and formally opening the football calendar. The exhibition traditionally serves as a showcase for roster bubble players rather than starters, with coaching staffs using it to evaluate depth before the first cutdown deadline. Training camps across the league are now in full swing, and the game marks the start of a three-week preseason slate leading into the regular-season opener in early September.

items.en: Jonathan Taylor Agrees to Two-Year, $44 Million Extension With the Colts
items.zh: Jonathan Taylor 與小馬隊達成 2 年 4400 萬美元續約
items.summary: Indianapolis running back Jonathan Taylor agreed to a two-year, 44 million dollar extension, resolving one of the more closely watched contract situations of the summer and reinforcing a rebound in the market for elite running backs. The deal keeps Taylor in Indianapolis through the medium term after a season in which he re-established himself as the offence's centrepiece. Elsewhere in camp news, Odell Beckham Jr drew attention with his form at Giants practice, citing LeBron James as a model for extending a career into his mid-thirties.

items.en: US Open Main Draw Set for August 30 as Tennis Enters Its Hard-Court Run
items.zh: 美網 8/30 開打，網壇進入硬地賽季衝刺
items.summary: The US Open main draw begins on Sunday, August 30 at Flushing Meadows, closing out a hard-court swing that runs through the Canadian and Cincinnati Masters events in August. The final Grand Slam of the season carries outsized ranking implications for players still chasing year-end championship qualification. August's wider sporting calendar also includes the resumption of European domestic football, the athletics circuit, and a busy Formula One stretch, making it one of the densest months on the annual schedule.

items.en: Campus Mental Health Access Gaps Persist Into the 2026 Academic Year
items.zh: 2026 學年開學在即，校園心理資源可近性仍是缺口
items.summary: Reviews of campus mental health provision heading into the 2026 academic year continue to identify access, not awareness, as the binding constraint. Geographic distance from services and a shortage of qualified clinicians leave many students waiting weeks for a first appointment, with the gap widest for commuter and rural-campus populations. Researchers argue universities should treat counselling capacity as infrastructure rather than a student-affairs add-on, and point to stepped-care models that route lower-acuity cases to trained peer support so clinical hours go to students in greater need.

items.en: Half of Lifetime Mental Health Conditions Begin by Age 14, Reviews Reiterate
items.zh: 回顧研究再次指出：半數心理健康問題在 14 歲前就開始
items.summary: Statistical reviews of student mental health continue to cite the finding that roughly half of lifetime mental health conditions have their onset by around age fourteen, though the exact age varies substantially by disorder. The figure is used to argue for earlier screening in secondary rather than tertiary education, since by the time students reach university many conditions are already several years established. Critics caution the headline number flattens real differences between anxiety, mood and psychotic disorders, which follow very different onset curves.

items.en: Educational Psychology Research Converges on Interdisciplinary Training Models
items.zh: 教育心理學研究轉向跨領域訓練模式
items.summary: Recent educational psychology scholarship increasingly argues that modernising curricula means integrating mental health training across disciplines rather than confining it to psychology departments, combining counselling technique, developmental psychology and crisis intervention in a single sequence. Departments presenting at recent APA conventions have concentrated on school-based intervention, loneliness in early childhood, and measurement of affect in classroom settings. The practical claim is that teachers and academic advisers, who see students far more often than counsellors do, are the highest-leverage point for early identification.

items.en: Claude Opus 5 Still Tops the Intelligence Index at Half of Fable 5's Price
items.zh: Claude Opus 5 續居智慧指數第一，價格只有 Fable 5 的一半
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus 5, released on July 24, continues to lead Artificial Analysis's Intelligence Index with a score of 61 while priced at five dollars per million input tokens and twenty-five per million output, roughly half the cost of Claude Fable 5. The pricing structure is being read as an attempt to hold the frontier-quality tier while Chinese labs undercut Western list prices from below. Anthropic separately launched a 1.5 billion dollar AI implementation joint venture with Blackstone and Hellman & Friedman, staffing it with about 100 engineers.

items.en: OpenAI Advances ChatGPT 6 as Security Testing Raises Red Flags
items.zh: OpenAI 推進 ChatGPT 6，安全測試卻亮紅燈
items.summary: OpenAI is pushing toward a ChatGPT 6 release expected in late summer 2026, but internal testing has surfaced significant cybersecurity vulnerabilities, prompting discussions with US officials about safety and broader societal impact. The disclosure lands amid a widening split in the industry between labs arguing that powerful models should be broadly accessible and those pressing for mandatory safety testing and stronger mechanisms to restrict dangerous capabilities. European and Californian regulators have meanwhile begun genuine enforcement rather than guidance-only supervision.

items.en: Gemini 3.6 Flash Underwhelms on Benchmarks as Google Pins Hopes on Gemini 4
items.zh: Gemini 3.6 Flash 跑分不如預期，Google 押注 Gemini 4
items.summary: Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash underperformed on recent benchmark suites, reviving questions about whether the company's speed-and-price positioning is costing it at the frontier. Attention has shifted to Gemini 4, which Google is expected to position as a direct answer on reasoning quality. In adjacent hardware news, AMD announced on August 6 that it had acquired a chip startup whose technology hardwires trained AI models directly into silicon, an approach aimed at cutting inference cost per token rather than chasing raw training throughput.

items.en: Fujii Kaze's Prema World Tour Brings Dome and Stadium Dates to Kaohsiung and Hong Kong
items.zh: ★ 藤井風 Prema World Tour：高雄、香港都有場！
items.summary: Fujii Kaze's first world tour, the Prema World Tour, spans six Asian cities across dome and stadium venues, with confirmed stops including Kaohsiung, Hong Kong and Bangkok alongside Japanese dates in Fukuoka on November 14-15, Osaka on December 10 and 12-13, and Tokyo on December 19-20. The domestic Pre:Prema warm-up run covered Sapporo, Hiroshima and Fukui through early August. It is his first domestic live in two years and first tour in three and a half. Taiwan on-sale details are still being staged through the official site.
items.source: Fujii Kaze Official / 音楽ナタリー

items.en: Mrs. GREEN APPLE Sets Sixth Album for September 30 With First Arena Tour in Three Years
items.zh: Mrs. GREEN APPLE 第六張專輯 9/30 發行，三年來首場巡迴同步啟動
items.summary: Mrs. GREEN APPLE will release their sixth original full-length album on September 30, paired with their first arena tour in three years. The band has been running a sixteen-date live run through the summer that includes Nippon Budokan and Ariake Arena, and is also fronting the CEREMONY project. No Taiwan or Hong Kong dates have been announced for this cycle, so the practical option for overseas fans remains chasing a Japan date or waiting for a possible Asia leg announcement after the album lands.

items.en: YOASOBI's Largest-Ever North America Run Closes at the Hollywood Bowl
items.zh: YOASOBI 史上最大北美巡迴，終站好萊塢露天劇場
items.summary: YOASOBI's NEVER ENDING STORIES tour is the duo's biggest North American run to date, combining six headline shows with festival appearances at OSHEAGA and Lollapalooza across eight dates, and closing at the 20,000-capacity Hollywood Bowl with Crunchyroll backing. The duo released the E-SIDE 4 EP in April. No Taiwan or Hong Kong stop is attached to this leg, though the pair have historically added Asian dates after completing a Western run, making an announcement in the back half of 2026 plausible but unconfirmed.

items.en: Ado's Nissan Stadium Show 'Ao' Heads to Streaming From September 27
items.zh: Ado 日產體育場公演「Ao」9/27 上線，五個月連續放送五場
items.summary: Ado's first Nissan Stadium concert, Ado STADIUM LIVE 2026 'Ao', held over July 4 and 5 at the roughly 72,000-capacity venue, will stream on Lemino Premium from September 27. It headlines a five-month run releasing five of her major concerts consecutively from September 2026 through January 2027, covering the National Stadium show, Budokan and her world tour. Her 2026 single 'Ai Ai A' features in the setlist. For fans in Taiwan this is the realistic way to see the show without travelling.

items.en: Vaundy's First Asia Arena Tour 'HORO' Still Lists a Taipei Stop
items.zh: ★ Vaundy 首次亞洲巡迴「HORO」台北場仍在名單上
items.summary: Vaundy's first Asia arena tour HORO opens September 5-6 in Chiba and runs through November with dates in Seoul, Hong Kong, Taipei and Shanghai, ahead of his largest-ever Japan arena tour scheduled for 2027-2028. He completed the SILENCE dome tour, which drew roughly 350,000 attendees, and announced the new song 'Idea ga Afurete Nemurenai' as the theme for a Fuji TV Monday-nine drama. Exact Taipei on-sale timing has still not been posted, so keep an eye on the tour page as September approaches.
